items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: Montague played with me until he got sick.

ctx.x: He comes back to you when you think about it.

Yeah, that's what I think of, yeah. Montague played with me until he got sick. Mm-hmm. And that's when Big Lord started with me. Mm-hmm. Then we quit there. We were off about two years. I went back again.
And that's why I went back with Big Lord again. Who was in there in those two years? Oh, a hillbilly band.
